name: SkipLink
rungReason: An in-page <a href="#main"> moves the sequential focus starting point natively; CSS only hides it until focus.

attributes.tabindex: -1 (optional; lets every engine move focus to it)

a11y.name: Its text, e.g. "Skip to main content"

keyboard.action: The first Tab stop on the page; it shows while focused
The next Tab goes into main

focus.indicator: :focus-visible outline; the link is pinned to the viewport's inline-start corner

rules: Render it first in <body>, before the header
Hidden with the visually-hidden technique, not display: none, so it stays in the Tab order
contrast: A strong border all the time
